verdict.rationale: Retell documents a built-in knowledge base: agents ship with one, and you can crawl a website or upload documents for the agent to retrieve from. Knowledge bases are also managed via the CLI and inspected by Conductor, including indexing status, and AI QA scores knowledge base accuracy. Evidence is limited to short overview statements, so missing for 10: a dedicated knowledge-base doc covering supported file types, chunking/retrieval configuration and API endpoints, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that answers are grounded in uploaded content.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ground the agent on my documents with a built-in knowledge base or RAG so it answers from my content

citations.quote: Crawl a website or upload documents your agent retrieves from.
Retell agents are node-based flows or single prompts, with call handling, a knowledge base, and integrations built in.
Conductor can inspect your knowledge bases, their source metadata, and indexing status.
Install the Retell CLI to manage agents, phone numbers, knowledge bases, and other Retell resources from your terminal with simple commands.
